label: prf:gauge-coupling-uniqueness
title: Proof of gauge coupling uniqueness
html: Proof. A scalar coupling factors through projection onto a singlet summand of A \otimes A. The completeness theorem provides exactly one such summand (V_- \cong \mathbf{1}, of R-rank one), and the projection onto it is e_-. Any R-linear, braid-invariant \phi \colon E \to R vanishing on V_+ therefore equals \lambda \cdot \mathrm{tr}_\tau(e_-) on e_-, with \lambda = \phi(e_-)/\mathrm{tr}_\tau(e_-) \in R. \square
